turns.question: What was the week-over-week growth in leads for the week starting 14 September 2026?
turns.answer: Leads grew 20.7 % over the week before for the week of 14 to 20 September 2026 (week-over-week growth of 0.207). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
